title: Accounts Assistant
description:

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts & Projects Assistant
- Location: Bristol
- Salary: £30,000 - £34,000
- Job Type: 30 - 37.5 hours per week

Join a well-established Bristol-based business as an Accounts & Projects Assistant. This role offers a unique blend of accounts administration, project support, and general business administration. It is perfect for someone who enjoys a broad, hands-on position within a supportive and collaborative environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Process purchase invoices and manage invoice approval processes.
- Raise sales invoices and support credit control activities.
- Perform regular bank reconciliations and assist with payment runs.
- Support month-end procedures and VAT submissions.
- Maintain accurate financial records and assist with process improvements.
- Provide administrative support across a range of business projects.
- Maintain project documentation and assist with cost tracking.
- Liaise with suppliers, tenants, clients, and other stakeholders.
- Support property and asset administration activities.
- Provide general office and administrative support as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Bookkeeper, or similar role.
- Strong understanding of purchase ledger, sales ledger, and bank reconciliations.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Professional and proactive approach to work.

Benefits:
- Flexible working hours with part-time and full-time options available.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Varied role with exposure to both finance and operational projects.
- Opportunity to grow and take on additional responsibilities over time.
- Company pension scheme.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays and additional time off over Christmas.

To apply for the Accounts & Projects Assistant position, please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role.

title: Credit Controller
description:
A financial services organisation based in north Bristol is currently recruiting a Credit Controller to join their team.

Working for a business that offers hybrid working, flexible hours, 25 days holiday (with the option to buy 5 more) plus other benefits, this is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to further their career within this field.

Duties will include:
- Regular review of debtor credit limits
- Chasing overdue debt over telephone and email
- Monitoring policies to ensure adequate limits are in place
- Assist clients with the running and understanding of their facility
- Meeting set KPI's
- Ensure client records are kept up to date
- Attendance at Portfolio meetings as required

Previous credit control experience is essential. The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate excellent relationship-building and customer service skills.

title: Part time Finance Assistant - 22. 5 hours per week
description:
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant searching for a new opportunity? We are looking for a Part Time Finance Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This role offers a great chance to be involved in essential financial processes, supporting the wider business with purchase ledger tasks, reconciliation, and basic account management. You'll be working closely with the finance team, ensuring smooth and accurate handling of transactions, all while maintaining a welcoming and professional approach. The position is office-based in Bath, perfect for someone looking to balance work and personal commitments, with a flexible, part-time schedule.

DAY TO DAY:
- Accounts payable, processing supplier invoices, using ApprovalMax, ensuring all invoices are allocated correctly, preparing invoices for approval
- Maintain the Accounts payable ledger and payment runs
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolving discrepancies, supplier onboarding and data capture
- Accounts receivable to include checking of rents, service charges, credit control, chasing payments, providing reports to Financial Controller
- Maintaining the ledger, allocating receipts, updating tenant accounts,
- Daily bank reconciliations, posting receipts and journals as needed, credit card reconciliations, tenant deposits,
- Providing reports to the team for service charge budgets using Xero, liaising with wider team re all finance queries,
- Assisting in the preparation of month-end, assisting with preparation of year-end
- Maintain an organised digital filing system, support FC with any other duties, support wider team when required

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Previous experience as a Finance or Accounts Assistant, ideally in property or similar sector
- Knowledge of purchase ledger processes and financial reconciliations
- Confidence using accounting software, with experience in Xero being highly desirable
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

AND FOR YOU:
- Benefits include competitive salary
- Flexible working hours - 5 shorter days or 3 full days
- Central Bath, modern office environment in established team

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Payroll Assistant
- Rate; Up to £250 (via umbrella/inside IR35)
- Location; Bristol (3x weekly onsite)
- Duration; 6 month initial contract

We are looking for a Payroll Assistant to support the delivery, control and financial accounting of payroll activity across multiple jurisdictions. This is a varied role that combines payroll operations, payroll accounting, compliance and colleague support.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the accurate and timely delivery of a monthly payroll for approximately 2,000 employees.
- Process payroll changes including starters, leavers, family leave, sickness absence and employee benefits.
- Review monthly payroll activity and provide clear explanations for changes in employee pay.
- Produce payroll controls and supporting documentation for management approval.
- Respond to payroll related colleague queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Manage payroll tax activities, including taxable benefits and PAYE Settlement Agreement requirements.
- Calculate payroll adjustments relating to employee share option exercises.
- Prepare and post payroll related accounting journals and reconciliations.
- Support the accurate accounting of payroll costs, liabilities and provisions.
- Maintain payroll procedures, controls and process documentation.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation, compliance requirements and payroll systems.
